methodologyNote: Slowdown Risk Score (0-100): derived from CO vs. US unemployment differential, using FRED data. Score < 34 = Low, 34-66 = Moderate, 67+ = Elevated. Additional indicators (housing permits, consumer confidence) will be incorporated as data sources are confirmed.
dataQualityNote: Insufficient data to compute score. FRED API key required.
